data.name: Lulu
data.gender_notes: Lulu is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A pet name derived from the Arabic name Lulwah which means 'light' or 'pearl'. It is also believed to be derived from the Arabic word 'lilah' which means 'night' and is a pet form of Aisha or Fatima. This name evokes a sense of sweetness, innocence, and mystery. The name Lulu carries the meaning “Small Secret” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English, French. Parents who choose Lulu usually hope their child will grow to embody small secret and live with faith, good character and purpose.
